C1081.title: Unlicensed Fireworks Transport Convicted as Dangerous Operations Offense
C1081.summary: A truck driver in Yangxin County, Hubei, surnamed Zhu, without hazardous materials transport credentials or a qualification certificate, was hired by a fellow villager surnamed Ke. Between March 2024 and March 2025, he made 12 trips illegally transporting fireworks from Jiangxi to Hubei, moving over 4,600 boxes and earning 26,500 yuan.
